network_status.network: Val Passiria: strada chiusa tra San Martino e San Leonardo
network_status.summary_it: La fonte provinciale documenta la colata detritica, l'ostruzione del torrente e gli interventi di sgombero tra San Martino e San Leonardo, ma non pubblica una misura idrometrica sul Valclava. Il volume di materiale mobilizzato non viene trattato come livello o portata d'acqua.
network_status.summary_en: The provincial source documents the debris flow, stream obstruction and clearance works between San Martino and San Leonardo but publishes no Valclava hydrometric measurement. Mobilised debris volume is not treated as water stage or discharge.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
